delay_description: Unfurnished property — setup capital must be spent

trigger_phrases.phrase: Property is fully unfurnished — full setup investment required before it can go live
Wants a firm, itemised furnishing cost rather than a verbal ballpark estimate
Wants to research furnishing/upgrade costs before deciding
Setup/furnishing requirements need to be assessed
Won't commit to furnishing spend until the STL income case is proven worthwhile
Rooms need staging/neutralising (e.g. children's bedrooms) before listing photography
Deciding whether to self-supply furnishings/appliances or use Stayful staging

typical_timeline.notes: Timelines were rarely stated explicitly (9 of 11 entries gave none); where a window was given it was short — 1-2 weeks to research costs or receive an itemised list — implying the blocker resolves in weeks once a firm quote lands, not months.

what_leads_focus_on_while_waiting.concern: Getting a firm, itemised cost instead of Zac's verbal ballpark (e.g. £6,000-£8,000)
Comparing self-furnishing/self-sourcing cost against Stayful's furnishing quote
Needing photos or room dimensions sent before an accurate quote can even be produced
Whether the projected income justifies the furnishing spend at all
Additional non-furniture upgrades (amenities, photography, reaching a review count) alongside furnishing

how_to_handle_in_meeting.acknowledge_phrase: I would say it's probably going to be in the region of sort of 6,000, maybe up to sort of 8,000 pounds to fully do everything.
how_to_handle_in_meeting.timeline_question: If you can send me the room dimensions and a couple of photos, I can turn that ballpark into a firm itemised quote — how soon could you get those over?
how_to_handle_in_meeting.reframe_approach: Move the conversation from an abstract spend to a concrete, itemised list tied to their specific rooms, so the lead is deciding against real numbers rather than a round-number estimate.
how_to_handle_in_meeting.how_to_keep_engaged: Send the furniture/upgrade checklist or itemised quote as the very next action, with a short, named follow-up date to review it together rather than leaving costing as an open-ended homework item.
how_to_handle_in_meeting.what_to_write_to_monday: Log the ballpark figure given on the call, whether the lead wants to self-furnish or use Stayful staging, and what's still needed from them (photos, dimensions, a decision) to convert the estimate into a signed-off quote.

do_not_attempt_offer_because: Until the lead has an itemised cost and has decided whether to spend it, there is nothing for a signing-deadline discount to attach to — a time-limited management-fee offer does not change a lead's need to first find several thousand pounds of furnishing capital and confirm the numbers still work once that cost is included.
